D_firmware_limits.note: both above 2500 N/s: the firmware does not cap the ramp (the start ramp kStartRamp_Nps 2500 N/s is the COMB start cap, active only from RUN entry until the command is first met)

limitations: HV69 torque-speed line from retailer copies of MKS data (stall torque, s/60 deg at no load); linear line ASSUMED; B-PNT-1 measures speed under load and the opening/closing slew under the L0/L1/L2 load laws
friction ASSUMED (Mechanical baseline); the guide mu 0.02 + S 5 N sensitivity of pintle_dynamics_v3 slows the opening
quasi-steady thrust map: the chamber filling and fuel thermal lag (Combustion) add to the thrust response, not to the drive rate
the thrust rate in 6-DOF terms (GNC) is a command-rate limit; this check is the actuator capability under load
